title: One person walking
caption: The ring follows the walker closely. Movement disturbs many radio links at once, which is the easiest case.

title: Sitting still
caption: Once the person stops, the signal change is small. The track holds but the estimate wanders more.

title: Behind a wall
caption: Radio goes through the partition, weakened. The person is still found, with more error near the wall.

title: Two people crossing
caption: Each person gets a ring. When they pass close together the two can be swapped.

title: Three people
caption: More bodies means overlapping signal. Detections get rougher and one person can be missed for a while.

title: Weak signal
caption: Low signal and lost packets slow detection down. The status line flags the weak input.

title: Empty room
caption: Nobody is there and nothing is drawn. Noise alone does not create a person.

title: Too few sensors
caption: With a single radio link the position cannot be worked out, so the system says so instead of guessing.
